title: "Unveiling the Origins: Ghost and Tommy's Journey in the 'Power' Universe"
htmlContent:
Starz has ignited excitement among fans of its hit series "Power" by announcing the latest addition to its expanding universe – "Origins." This new prequel series delves into the beginnings of two iconic characters, Ghost and Tommy, portrayed by Omari Hardwick and Joseph Sikora respectively in the original "Power."

Set to be helmed by Sascha Penn, known for his work on "Power Book III: Raising Kanan," "Origins" promises to offer a captivating narrative that uncovers the roots of the inseparable duo whose presence has loomed large over the "Power" saga.

The initial "Power" series, which premiered in 2014, introduced viewers to James St. Patrick, alias "Ghost," a shrewd nightclub entrepreneur and formidable drug dealer. Alongside him was his loyal childhood friend, Tommy, forming an indomitable partnership in their realm of power and influence.

"Origins" emerges hot on the heels of the success of its predecessors, including "Power Book II: Ghost," gearing up for its highly anticipated Season 4 in 2024. Concurrently, "Power Book III: Raising Kanan" is currently in production for its fourth season in the bustling streets of New York, while "Power Book IV: Force" is actively filming its third season in the urban landscape of Chicago.

Kathryn Busby, President of Programming at Starz, expressed enthusiasm for the forthcoming series, acknowledging the fervent connection fans have established with the "Power" universe. She anticipates "Origins" to continue evolving the franchise while delivering fresh and gripping storytelling to the dedicated audience.

The "Power" series universe is the brainchild of Courtney A. Kemp, the visionary creator and original showrunner of "Power," who spearheads the production through her company End of Episode. Joining her are industry titans Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson, representing G-Unit Film and Television, and Mark Canton of Canton Entertainment, ensuring the continuation of the franchise's legacy.

With "Origins," viewers can expect to embark on an enthralling journey back to the genesis of Ghost and Tommy's formidable partnership. As the series explores the defining moments that shaped these characters, it promises to deepen our understanding of their motivations, loyalties, and the intricate web of power they navigate.

The announcement of "Origins" marks a significant milestone as Starz celebrates the imminent 10-year anniversary of "Power." It stands as a testament to the enduring appeal and cultural impact of the franchise, which continues to captivate audiences with its riveting storytelling and compelling characters.

As fans eagerly anticipate the unveiling of Ghost and Tommy's untold origins, "Origins" holds the promise of enriching the "Power" universe with new layers of intrigue, drama, and revelations. Prepare to witness the birth of legends as we journey back to where it all began.
excerpt: Unveil the compelling backstories of Ghost and Tommy in the 'Power' universe, highlighting their paths, struggles, and influence within the series.
